reason: An image-to-text bridge for DeepSeek Harness that converts pasted attachments or workspace images through configured vision and OCR routes, with concurrent model racing and CLI configuration.

summaries.zh: 将粘贴的图片或工作区图像通过配置的视觉模型和 OCR 路由转换为文本，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。
summaries.en: Converts pasted attachments or workspace images into text through configured vision and OCR routes for use in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads pasted Web attachments and explicitly requested workspace image files
Sends image data to configured cloud vision, OCR, relay, or local model endpoints
Converts vision or OCR results into text for a text-only DeepSeek model
Provides CLI commands for configuration, API key setup, status, model routing, and verification
Caches results and applies configured timeouts, size limits, and file-path confinement
